subject: Compile-time boolean expressions
notes: kb/Work PB1370 landed (wave 66 h). Rule (cite.py --check 7.3.7.2 'Compile-time boolean expressions shall be formed in accordance with 8.8.2, Boolean expressions' -> OK §7.3.7.2 1)). The three divergences the adjudication measured are closed in the ONE model both lanes share: (a) a parenthesized boolean literal with no operator - §8.8.2 'a boolean expression enclosed in parentheses' (--check OK) - is recognized by boolExprAhead/boolArgAhead (ParenRunOpensOnBoolLiteral: a grouping-paren run opening on a BOOLLIT can only be boolean), so >>DEFINE X AS (B"101"), >>IF (B"1") = B"1" and >>EVALUATE (B"1") evaluate, and so do the runtime siblings IF (B"1") = F / IF F = (B"1") / INTEGER-OF-BOOLEAN((B"1010")); (b) the shift count is held to Table 4's single identifier-or-literal by the shared ArithmeticFormationRules screen (rule 5 --check OK; rule 6 --check OK) and to an INTEGER literal by form (§5.5 2) a) --check OK; §8.3.3.3.2 'An integer literal is a fixed-point numeric literal that contains no decimal point' --check OK) - 1 + 1, 2 * 1, (1), - 1, 1.0, and a variable holding 1.5 are COBOL1619; (c) the directive stage asks the ONE BooleanOperatorGate (shared with VersionConformancePass), so a B-SHIFT-* in >>DEFINE / >>IF at 2002/2014 is COBOL0900 like its runtime twin (§E.2 3) --check OK); BooleanExpressionGateSiteDriftTests now requires both fragment sites to be gated instead of exempting them.
